name: 高透抗刮钢化膜三片装款
description: 高清高透强抗刮，定位框免对齐一贴即合，三片装安心备用

styleLock.direction: clean tech-minimal phone-accessory e-commerce: black-gold retail anchor plus light-blue studio feature demos, one benefit per frame
styleLock.temperature: cool neutral studio light, warm gold only on retail packaging and test sparks
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF for retail hero and variant; soft light-blue gradient studio #BFD4EF to #C9DAF2 for feature demos; deepest dusty blue #8B95B2 to #98A2BE reserved for the install CTA frame
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft diffuse studio light, edge-lit glass with diagonal light streaks, faint contact shadows only, no hard shadows
styleLock.surfaceSystem: high-transparency tempered glass with white edge outline, matte black retail card, translucent alignment frame plastic
styleLock.typography: bold short sans-serif headlines in slate blue #3D6CB8 on light grounds and white #FFFFFF on dark grounds, one title plus one subline maximum
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line rounded-square icons in single blue #3D6CB8 on light grounds, at most six per frame
styleLock.presentationRules: product occupies 55-75% in feature frames and 25-30% in packshots, one claim per frame, glass always edge-lit and tack sharp, human hand appears only in the install frame, variant frames reuse the exact hero composition
noDrift: no warm wood or homey grounds
no third-party phone brand marks or greeting wallpapers
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: clean tech-minimal e-commerce suite for a tempered glass screen protector. Black-and-gold retail hero with stacked glass sheets and a translucent alignment frame on pure white #FFFFFF; feature demos sit on soft light-blue studio backdrops #BFD4EF to #C9DAF2 where floating glass is edge-lit with white outlines and diagonal light streaks; a macro corner-fit frame shows white glow arcs; a durability test fires golden sparks #F0C868; the easy-install CTA runs on the deepest dusty blue #8B95B2 with a purple alignment frame #B65AD4 and a single fingertip. Bright soft diffuse studio light, faint contact shadows, no hard shadows. Bold short sans-serif headlines in slate blue #3D6CB8 or white #FFFFFF, thin-line blue icons, one benefit per frame. The privacy variant reuses the exact hero composition with smoky-gray glass #55565A and a cyan frame #3AC4D6. Strip all brand marks; never show compatibility charts, red warning banners, third-party device logos or fabricated certificates.

shots.intent: 第一眼建立零售形象：三片装玻璃膜与附赠定位框同框
shots.camera: frontal eye-level render, matte black retail card standing on the left, three glass sheets staggered diagonally to the right, translucent frame layered in front
shots.lighting: soft frontal studio light, glass edges self-outlined, minimal shadow
shots.promptTemplate: {style_lock}. Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. Frontal eye-level: a plain matte black retail card #0D0D0F stands at the left, three tempered glass sheets stagger along a diagonal to the right with crisp white edge outlines, one translucent alignment frame floats in front. Soft frontal studio light, faint base shadow only. Seamless white #FFFFFF. Product occupies 70-75%, whitespace 20-25%. No overlaid text. 2K commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no brand logos or printed marks, no gold lettering, no hands, no watermark, no cut-off edges, no colored background.
